name: unary-request-with-server-push-interleaved
description: The example of WSM-TST-002, with the two corrections the rule in the same paragraph demands: streams are named by ordinal and every matcher names the peer whose wire it searches. A server push crosses an unanswered unary request in the other direction and neither disturbs the other - the symmetry of WSM-INV-002, which is the property that makes a push an ordinary open with the roles swapped. max_frame_bytes is a runner instruction (WSM-FRG-005): at 64 the request's own open does not fit and is fragmented, so this also proves a unary request survives fragmentation of its opening payload (WSM-FRG-021).
